description: Procurement for the supply of 1,100,000 Peritoneal dialysis solution bags
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the international competitive procurement method for the supply of 1,100,000 Peritoneal dialysis solution bags used to remove waste products and excess fluid from the bodies of dialysis patients with acute or chronic renal failure who are undergoing dialysis. Two (02) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Infuxion Lanka (Private) Limited of Sri Lanka (Manufacturer: Peritone Health SDN BHD, Malaysia), substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a sum of 990 million Rupees based on the recommendation of the High Level Procurement Committee submitted after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
